statement_blocker: The catalog supplies a DG method label and a short family description, not a proposition. Even the likely Reed-Hill source contains a transport discretization construction plus several empirical stability, accuracy, and iteration comparisons, not one general theorem. The repository fixes no PDE variant, domain, mesh, broken spaces, traces, numerical flux or penalty, boundary data, conclusion, norm, rate, constants, or analytic-versus-experimental boundary. Selecting a Reed-Hill construction, local unisolvence result, modern DG stability/error theorem, or benchmark proposition would change the target.
target_decision: redirect the catalog method label to one independently reviewed, immutable-source proposition before exact statement or proof execution
domain_and_universes: Open: an accepted root must fix the PDE and coefficient domain, physical domain and dimension, mesh and face types, broken trial/test spaces, scalar field, traces and fluxes, norms, universes, finiteness, measurability, completeness, and every typeclass context.
